newsitem.title: USA: Permanent Bancorp has agreement on loans.
newsitem.headline: Permanent Bancorp has agreement on loans.

text.p: Permanent Bancorp Inc said Wednesday it reached a tentative agreement to pay off two additional commercial real estate loans that are being carried as nonperforming assets.
It said the payoffs will not result in any additional loss to the company.

The two credits totaled $3 million, and their payoff would lower the company's ratio of non-performing assets to total assets to about 1.10 percent. This ratio was reported at 1.75 percent at March 31, 1996 and at 2.43 percent at March 31, 1995.
